entities.name: Ru-nora
entities.description: An island in the southern Domains of Dominaria with a dormant volcano where the Ru-nor live.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: Ancestors of the Ru-nor; five tribes escaped Terisiare.

entities.name: Vodalian Empire
entities.description: Controls some of the island's ports.

entities.name: Deathwings
entities.description: Swarm of dragons that attacked the islanders.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Region the five Thran tribes escaped.

events.summary: Five Thran tribes who survived the war sailed to Ru-nora and settled it.
events.quote: There, they settled and began rebuilding their lives.

events.summary: After 88 years the Ru-nor were attacked by swarming dragons they named Deathwings, and many died.
events.quote: they were attacked by a swarm of dragons that the Ru-nor named "Deathwings"

events.summary: The islanders built dragon-bone kites to attack the dragons, repeating every 150 years.
events.quote: they started building kites made of dragon skin and dragon bone

relations.quote: The Ru-nor inhabitants of Ru-nora are descendants of the Thran
